rows.grounds: locative plural of mekhalā, referring to the ritual terraces or girdles
compound of dīpa (lamp) and mālā (garland or row)

items.question: Where must the garland of lamps be arranged within the ritual enclosures?
premises: The ritual space includes multiple enclosures called mekhalās.
The instruction applies to all these enclosures without exception.
A garland of lamps is the object to be arranged.
items.inference: Therefore, one should arrange a garland of lamps on all the enclosures.
uncertainties: The precise architectural form of the mekhalās in this ritual context is not specified.
items.plain_english: One should arrange a garland of lamps on all the enclosures.
